notes: The sheet carries no overall room, wall-to-wall or building dimensions; the only written dimensions are three chains of three 4'-0" bays that establish the pier module of the window bands (kitchen north wall, guest room west wall, living room south wall). Other measurable information is given only by the graphic bar scale (labelled 1, 5, 10, 15, presumably feet) and the written scale 1/8" = 1'-0. All lettering, including the dimension strings, was clearly legible on the 4x3 tiles; no finer crops were required. The remaining text on the sheet is the drawing title, room names (GUEST ROOM, KITCHEN, SERVANTS, LIVING ROOM, DINING ROOM), stair annotations (UP, DOWN), a north arrow, a note block describing alterations, and the title block.
